******************************************************************
*STATA syntax code for the computation of index*
*values with the Danish value set (DCE and TTO hybrid)*
*Reference: Jensen CE, Sørensen SS, Gudex C, Jensen MB, Pedersen KM, Ehlers LH. The Danish EQ-5D-5L Value Set: A Hybrid Model Using cTTO and DCE Data. Appl Health Econ Health Policy. 2021 Jul;19(4):579-591.
*Source: https://euroqol.org/information-and-support/resources/value-sets/
******************************************************************;
gen disut_mo = .
replace disut_mo = 0 if missing(disut_mo) & mobility == 1
replace disut_mo = 0.041 if missing(disut_mo) & mobility == 2
replace disut_mo = 0.054 if missing(disut_mo) & mobility == 3
replace disut_mo = 0.157 if missing(disut_mo) & mobility == 4
replace disut_mo = 0.22 if missing(disut_mo) & mobility == 5

gen disut_sc = .
replace disut_sc = 0 if missing(disut_sc) & selfcare == 1
replace disut_sc = 0.035 if missing(disut_sc) & selfcare == 2
replace disut_sc = 0.050 if missing(disut_sc) & selfcare == 3
replace disut_sc = 0.144 if missing(disut_sc) & selfcare == 4
replace disut_sc = 0.209 if missing(disut_sc) & selfcare == 5

gen disut_ua = .
replace disut_ua = 0 if missing(disut_ua) & activity == 1
replace disut_ua = 0.033 if missing(disut_ua) & activity == 2
replace disut_ua = 0.040 if missing(disut_ua) & activity == 3
replace disut_ua = 0.139 if missing(disut_ua) & activity == 4
replace disut_ua = 0.174 if missing(disut_ua) & activity == 5

gen disut_pd = .
replace disut_pd = 0 if missing(disut_pd) & pain == 1
replace disut_pd = 0.048 if missing(disut_pd) & pain == 2
replace disut_pd = 0.094 if missing(disut_pd) & pain == 3
replace disut_pd = 0.381 if missing(disut_pd) & pain == 4
replace disut_pd = 0.537 if missing(disut_pd) & pain == 5

gen disut_ad = .
replace disut_ad = 0 if missing(disut_ad) & anxiety == 1
replace disut_ad = 0.072 if missing(disut_ad) & anxiety == 2
replace disut_ad = 0.191 if missing(disut_ad) & anxiety == 3
replace disut_ad = 0.430 if missing(disut_ad) & anxiety == 4
replace disut_ad = 0.618 if missing(disut_ad) & anxiety == 5

gen disut_total = disut_mo + disut_sc + disut_ua + disut_pd + disut_ad 

gen EQ_index = . 
replace EQ_index = 1 - disut_total
replace EQ_index = round(EQ_index, .001)
